title: Customer touchpoint briefing — daily working notes
content:
Day: 2026-05-28 — quick working notes (ramble, to-dos, snippets)

Top intent: carve out concrete next steps for 3 accounts with upcoming milestones. Keep short, actionable. Use this doc to capture call snippets and quick email copy.

-- Morning triage (before 9:30AM)
- Scan inbox for renewals flagged last week: Halcyon Health (renewal window 2026-06-15), Beacon Learning (renewal 2026-07-02), AtlasFin (early churn risk)
- Prioritize Halcyon — internal kickoff at 10:00 with Solutions + AMs to align on pricing ask and feature list
- Quick check: any Sev1s overnight? None. Two open tickets: CS-4823 (integration latency spike) and CS-4879 (embed mismatch) — flagged for eng on-call

Halcyon Health — renewal focus-
- Current seat: 45, annual contract, pilot for batch-embedding started Q1. Renewal: June 15 but Commercial wants decision by June 1.
- Risks: recent latency regression on large-batch uploads (ticket CS-4823), licensing ask to add 5 seats at >25% list price, legal needs updated DPA scoping
- Goals for 5/28 internal sync (10AM):
  - Confirm recommended uplift scenario (option A: seats + 10% discount for 12mo)
  - Decide on escalations needed for latency bug (is workaround acceptable for renewal?)
  - Draft initial renewal one-pager for CSM + AM to send (placeholder copy below)
- Notes-to-self for meeting: be explicit about rollback/fallback options, call out Redwood Private if they raise data residency concerns
- Email subject draft: "Halcyon renewal options — quick summary & timeline"
- Action items (owner):
  - Evelyn: draft renewal one-pager + SKU table (due 5/28 EOD)
  - Diego: confirm technical workaround ETA with eng on-call (pinged)
  - Legal (Priya): confirm DPA amendment timeline (cc: legal@redwood)
  - AM (Lukas): set stakeholder call with Halcyon execs for week of 6/1

Beacon Learning — QBR prep-
- QBR scheduled 6/10. Prep checklist: top 3 metrics, recent wins, open action items, roadmap asks
- Data to pull: token usage trend (past 90 days), top error classes, cost per 1k tokens by model variant
- Smaller ask: beacon trialed dedup caching last month — want impact numbers for QBR. Need case study snippet
- To-do: pull analytics report & draft 2 slides; find customer quote from kickoff notes (confluence link above)
- Action items:
  - Evelyn: populate slide deck template with usage numbers (due 6/2)
  - Analytics: export usage CSV (cc: analytics-team)

AtlasFin — early-warning follow-ups-
- Signals: decreased weekly usage, support ticket about hallucination in reranker, finance potentially moving to month-to-month
- Immediate: schedule 30m check-in to surface concerns and offer quick technical review
- Escalation criteria: if we cannot show a remediation plan within 7 days, flag as high-risk for churn
- Action items:
  - Evelyn: reach out with 2 options (deep-dive with PM vs. quick tune w/ eng) — email template snippet below
  - Solutions Eng: prepare short troubleshooting runbook for reranker false positives

Support follow-ups (quick list)
- CS-4823: latency spike — ping engineering on-call, request prioritization note, ask for expected ETA and mitigation steps. If ETA > 7 days, include in renewal deck as open risk.
- CS-4879: embedding mismatch — confirm whether this is model drift or preprocessing issue. If model drift, propose retrain cadence.

Meeting notes shorthand (10:00 Halcyon internal)
- Diego: workaround might reduce throughput by 20% but solves tail latency; need customer OK
- Lukas: AM asked for sensitivity on list-price increases — propose 10% uplift with volume discount
- Priya: DPA amendment needs 2 weeks if redline starts today
- Decision: present Option A (10% uplift + 3mo support credit) and Option B (maintain price + feature limited rollout)

Email snippet — Halcyon renewal one-pager (raw)
Subject: Halcyon renewal options + timeline (decision request by 2026-06-01)
Body (short):
Hi [Name],

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood. Ahead of your upcoming renewal (6/15), we wanted to call out two options tailored to your usage and roadmap:

Option A — Predictable expansion:
- Add 5 seats, priority throughput patch, 12-mo term, 10% uplift on per-seat pricing
- Includes 3 months of elevated support and a performance review session

Option B — Stable baseline:
- Maintain current pricing, 6-mo extension, limited feature rollout for batch ingestion optimizations

We recommend Option A if you expect growth >10% in next 12 months. Happy to walk through with your team next week.

— Evelyn

Parking lot / unresolved questions
- Do we have a compact ROI number for Halcyon using last 6 months of token usage? (ask analytics)
- Can Velocity team provide a short blurb on Private deployment availability in EU region?
- Is there a legal precedent for a 30-day trial extension bundled with renewal?

End-of-day checklist (5/28)
- Send Halcyon one-pager to AMs (by 3PM) — Evelyn
- Confirm eng ETA for CS-4823 (by EOD) — Diego
- Draft Beacon QBR slides starter (by EOD) — Evelyn
- Send AtlasFin outreach email (by 5PM) — Evelyn

Notes-to-self (informal)
- Keep email tone consultative, not salesy. Call out measurable impact (latency, cost per call) not just features.
- Re-use snippets from last renewal for boilerplate, but update numbers.
- If stuck, pull previous renewal deck from /shared_drives/company/renewal-archive (remember to anonymize usage numbers).

Quick email template — AtlasFin (short)
Subject: Quick sync? Possible fixes for reranker behavior
Body:
Hi [Name],
We noticed some changes in usage and a support ticket about the reranker producing surprising results. Can we schedule 30m this week to run through two quick remediation options? Option 1: short technical deep-dive with our Solutions Eng. Option 2: quick parameter tune + monitoring for 7 days. Which works?
Thanks, Evelyn

---
Timestamped edits: 2026-05-28 08:15 initial draft; 2026-05-28 09:48 added meeting notes; 2026-05-28 17:05 final action items

(End of working notes)
